snippet.title: Farlane — Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
This is an early reveal teaser for Farlane, a single-player sci-fi space adventure currently in development.

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4738820/Farlane/


Take command of a Nomad-class Frontier Runner and lead your skeleton crew on the edge of a fading galactic empire.

Your area of operation lies far from the wealthy worlds and crowded trade routes of the core systems, on the very edge of the known star maps. Out here, stations are scarce, law is thin, and the old farlanes slowly disappear into unknown space.

Take on freelance contracts including bounty hunting, mining operations, rescue missions, salvage work, and dangerous encounters beyond the frontier.

Your ship is more than transportation, it is your home.

Live and travel alongside your crew aboard a fully explorable ship interior. After battles, your crew repairs damaged systems, maintains critical equipment, and upgrades your vessel using technology, components, and valuable parts recovered from wrecks or purchased at distant stations.

Where the known universe ends, your adventure begins.

This footage represents an early work-in-progress build intended to showcase the game's atmosphere, setting, and direction. Gameplay and visuals subject to change.

Feedback is welcome.
